description: Browse Pipeworx packs. Returns pack names, tool counts, and gateway URLs. With no arguments it returns the first 25 packs plus total, returned and a note on how to narrow (the full catalog is about 2.5 MB, far too much to read in one go). Pass category to filter (free text, e.g. "weather"), or limit and offset to page through the list. To find the pack for a topic use search_packs instead.

category.description: Free-text filter matched against pack slugs, descriptions, and tool names/descriptions, not a fixed taxonomy (e.g. "weather", "pesticide", "sec filings"). Omit to browse the whole list, 25 packs at a time. A filtered call returns every match.

limit.description: Packs to return per page (1-5000). Default 25 when category is omitted; when category is given and limit is omitted, every match is returned.

offset.description: Entries to skip before the first one returned, for paging. Default 0. The previous response's next_offset is the value to pass.

name: list_packs
title: List Packs
